recognize_zh: CSF 抹片中數顆細胞核偏心、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質藍色且邊緣有出芽狀突起，呈漿細胞樣；右側一顆核呈多葉狀，屬於非典型漿細胞，符合骨髓瘤侵犯中樞神經。
features: Five plasmacytoid cells scattered on a clean cytospin background, some in pairs
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with irregular blebs and projections
One cell (right) with a lobulated/multilobed nucleus, an atypical plasma cell feature
No accompanying lymphocytes, neutrophils or red cells
describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows scattered plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm bearing irregular blebs. One cell has a lobulated nucleus, indicating nuclear atypia. No reactive inflammatory background is present in this field. In a patient with multiple myeloma and neurologic symptoms, findings are consistent with CSF involvement by plasma cell myeloma, which should be confirmed by flow cytometry demonstrating clonal CD38+/CD138+ plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are sparse, cytologically mature and admixed with lymphocytes and monocytes, and are polytypic by flow cytometry.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with fine chromatin and gray vacuolated cytoplasm, and reactive lymphocytes lack eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by lymphoma with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells express CD19/CD20 with a range of lymphoid sizes, whereas myeloma cells are CD19-/CD45-dim/CD138+.
